独立评测发现

来源：独立评审 · 口径 v2 · 源 Run 36498921009 / attempt 1

最新上游状态：未复核。原评审“已解决”不作为上游修复证明；应用绕行、业务 QA 通过均不关闭框架问题。

等级与类型怎么定
  • 严重阻塞交付，或造成数据丢失、安全问题，且没有合理绕行
  • 重要按指引或公开 API 正常使用会静默得到错误结果，或只能用非公开手段绕行
  • 轻微能完成，但要多花排查成本或在应用侧绕行
  • 信息措辞、示例完整度等不影响结果的改进
  • 实现缺陷实现违背文档或公开约定
  • 能力缺口需求属于框架职责，但缺少能力或公开接入
  • 指引错误指引、示例或注释写错，或彼此矛盾，照做会出错
  • 指引缺失指引缺少必要说明或示例，需要读源码或试探
  • 易用性改进现有能力可用，但有改进空间

重要指引错误上游未复核
F1 · 授权 Skill 的种子示例用 `.js` 相对导入，源码模式加载种子会失败

文档 / Skill / 示例 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization · @nocobase/db · 原评审：未解决

⌄

code-and-seeds.md 的两个示例把可复用声明与 seed-data 模块按 `.js` 相对路径导入（`../../server/sales-resources.js`、`../../seed-data/permission-sets.js`），读者会照抄到数据库种子链上。

评审时 · 文档 / API 声称

示例以 `.js` 相对路径导入可移植声明与种子数据模块，暗示该写法在种子/迁移加载链中可用。

评审时 · 实际观察

源码模式下任务加载器只重写任务文件自身 URL，传递导入不会被重写；`Cannot find module '.../database/seed-data/it-tickets.js'` 使种子与依赖它的启动测试失败，最终需把种子链改为 `.ts` 说明符。

实际影响
在源码/测试模式下，@nocobase/db 通过原生 Node 类型擦除直接 import `.ts` 任务文件，只对任务文件自身 URL 做 `.js`→`.ts` 重写，不重写其传递导入；种子链上的 `.js` 说明符解析失败，导致应用启动与种子测试失败。
建议改法
在 Skill 的代码/种子示例中使用 `.ts` 相对说明符（tsc emit 会经 rewriteRelativeImportExtensions 改写为 `.js`），或在文档中显式说明源码模式对传递导入的解析限制。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
按 code-and-seeds.md 的示例，在 seed-data 与 database/main/seeds 之间使用 `.js` 相对说明符。
应有能力 / 行为
种子在源码模式与编译模式下都能解析同一条导入链。
实际观察
源码模式仅重写顶层任务文件 URL，传递导入的 `.js` 解析失败并抛出 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND，种子整体失败。
应用绕行与代价
把种子可达导入链改为 `.ts` 说明符；tsc emit 时再改写为 `.js`。
改进后的验收标准
Skill 示例与说明改用 `.ts`（或说明源码模式限制）后，按示例编写的种子在源码与编译两种模式下都能加载。

        });
    }
    return path;

/** A directory and a source array are two ways to say the same thing. */
export function assertTaskSourceForm(kind, options) {
    if (options.directory !== undefined && options.sources !== undefined) {
        throw new Error(`${kind} options cannot define both directory and sources.`);
    }
    if (options.directory === undefined && options.sources === undefined) {
        throw new Error(`${kind} options must define directory or sources.`);

}
export function validateTaskDirectory(kind, directory) {
    if (!isNonEmptyString(directory)) {
        throw new Error(`${kind} directory must be a non-empty string.`);
    }
    return directory;
}
export function validateTaskPackageName(kind, packageName) {
    if (!isNonEmptyString(packageName)) {
        throw new Error(`${kind} packageName must be a non-empty string.`);
    }
    return packageName;
}
/** A source that does not exist holds no tasks; it is not an error. */
export async function readTaskDirectory(directory) {
    try {
        return await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
    }
    catch (error) {
        if (isNodeError(error) && error.code === 'ENOENT') {
            return [];
        }
        throw error;
    }
}
export function isTaskFile(fileName, extensions) {
    if (fileName.startsWith('.') || fileName.endsWith('.d.ts')) {
        return false;
    }
    return extensions.has(extname(fileName));
}
export function taskNameFromFileName(fileName) {
    return basename(fileName, extname(fileName));
}
/** The mtime query keeps a re-read after an edit from serving a cached module. */
export async function importTaskDefinition(filePath, mtimeMs) {

### [重要][指引错误] 授权 Skill 的种子示例用 `.js` 相对导入，源码模式加载种子会失败

**相关对象**：`app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization`、`@nocobase/db`（评审时 1.0.0-beta.16）

code-and-seeds.md 的两个示例把可复用声明与 seed-data 模块按 `.js` 相对路径导入（`../../server/sales-resources.js`、`../../seed-data/permission-sets.js`），读者会照抄到数据库种子链上。

**文档 / API 声称**：示例以 `.js` 相对路径导入可移植声明与种子数据模块，暗示该写法在种子/迁移加载链中可用。

**实际观察**：源码模式下任务加载器只重写任务文件自身 URL，传递导入不会被重写；`Cannot find module '.../database/seed-data/it-tickets.js'` 使种子与依赖它的启动测试失败，最终需把种子链改为 `.ts` 说明符。

**影响**：在源码/测试模式下，@nocobase/db 通过原生 Node 类型擦除直接 import `.ts` 任务文件，只对任务文件自身 URL 做 `.js`→`.ts` 重写，不重写其传递导入；种子链上的 `.js` 说明符解析失败，导致应用启动与种子测试失败。

**建议改动**：在 Skill 的代码/种子示例中使用 `.ts` 相对说明符（tsc emit 会经 rewriteRelativeImportExtensions 改写为 `.js`），或在文档中显式说明源码模式对传递导入的解析限制。

**验收标准**：Skill 示例与说明改用 `.ts`（或说明源码模式限制）后，按示例编写的种子在源码与编译两种模式下都能加载。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/code-and-seeds.md:38–41` — 示例用 `../../server/sales-resources.js` 相对导入可移植声明。
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/code-and-seeds.md:67–70` — 示例用 `../../seed-data/permission-sets.js` 相对导入种子数据模块。
- `packages/@nocobase/db/dist/src/migration/internal/task-loader.js:1–61` — DEFAULT_TASK_EXTENSIONS 含 .ts；importTaskDefinition 只对任务文件自身 URL 调用 __rewriteRelativeImportExtension 后 import()，不重写其传递导入。
- `artifacts/agent-history/agent-implement.jsonl/part-0046.txt:1885–1887` — 种子执行失败的完整测试输出：AppDatabaseTaskError: Database seeds failed ... Cannot find module '.../database/seed-data/it-tickets.js' imported from .../database/main/seeds/202609300002_it_tickets_demo_users.ts（ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND）。
- `artifacts/retro.json:9–13` — 四条经验：根挂载路由不用 use('*')；CSRF Origin；源模式种子需 .ts 说明符；可选插件缺失时干净降级。
- `artifacts/retro.json:15–21` — 检查全通过：scoped/full vitest 45 文件 353 用例、tsc、eslint --max-warnings 0、prettier、tsc emit 说明符重写确认。

完整验证和多方言选择见[验证指南](./docs/zh-CN/agent/verification.md)。

## 当前边界

- Repository、Select AST、Filter Builder、Filter AST 和 Sort AST 是未来提案，当前不可调用。
- QueryAdapter 是数据库层查询接口，不读取 Collection Metadata。
- `connection.client()` 是底层 adapter 逃生口，不是常规数据库入口。
packages/@nocobase/db/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:193–209E24

以表格说明 Repository 负责关系读取、withPolicy 行范围/写白名单、乐观锁、游标分页、方言编码；Query 负责无关系 join、子查询、分组分页。

**Is the unit of work a Collection's records, or a result set?** Records of one Collection and the things related to them are Repository's job. A shape that is not any Collection's records — a report joining unrelated tables, a set aggregated then paginated — is Query's.

| The task needs                                       | Use        |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| Reading a relation, or a nested create/update/delete | Repository |
| Optimistic locking through a `version` field         | Repository |
| A row scope or write allow list (`withPolicy`)       | Repository |
| Cursor pagination over a stable sort                 | Repository |
| Collection-level naming overrides to be honored      | Repository |
| Dialect-correct JSON and temporal encoding on write  | Repository |
| A join between tables with no relation between them  | Query      |
| A subquery, or conditions composed programmatically  | Query      |
| Paging or limiting a grouped result                  | Query      |

The costly mistake is rebuilding a relation read as a hand-written join because the join is familiar. That loses the naming mapping, the relation metadata and the write path that goes with it, and it has to be maintained against a schema the Collection definition already describes. If the records belong to a Collection, start from Repository and only drop to Query for the part Repository genuinely cannot express.

They mix freely inside one transaction — take both from the callback `connection`, as the example in [Transactions](#5-transactions) does.

本次评审 NocoBase3 基础框架（packages 的库/插件与 app/.agents 指引），以 Issue #474 的 IT 报修工单实现及 verify-1 浏览器验收作为使用证据，不重复 QA。分 5 个能力单元：授权与权限集、数据层（迁移/种子/策略化 Repository）、服务端路由与认证/DI、客户端路由与 i18n、用户与工作权限分配。总体：框架以 composite 动作 + record access 数据范围 + Repository withPolicy 的组合直接支撑“按操作区分本人/全部记录”，服务端与客户端授权、可选插件降级、用户/权限集分配均可正常组合，B01–B05 首轮验收全部通过。发现两处文档/指引缺陷：授权 Skill 的种子示例用 `.js` 相对导入，在源码模式（Node 类型擦除）下种子导入链解析失败；db 包中文 README 声称 Repository 等“当前不可调用”，与其 SKILL 和运行时不符。UI 因当前模型无法解析 PNG 未评审。

NocoBase3 库、插件、模板与指引 3

做得好的地方
F3 · 路由中间件作用域指引有效避免越权或漏保护

NocoBase3 内核 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/server-routes.md

⌄

server-routes.md 明确指出顶层 router.use('*', ...) 会泄漏到后挂载的贡献，导致无关端点被保护或自家端点漏保护，并给出按显式路径/子路由挂载的做法。

提供的帮助
App 在应用根挂载路由时能避免把认证/授权中间件错误扩散到其他贡献，降低安全缺陷风险。
应保留的能力
无需改动；建议保留该反例并继续在其他路由示例中复用。
E30 E46 E57
做得好的地方
F4 · composite 动作 + Repository policy 在声明层绑定记录范围与操作

NocoBase3 内核 · @nocobase/authorization · @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization

⌄

composite 资源把每个业务动作展开为一组底层授权，数据范围经 record access 解析为行条件，服务端一次 authorize 后以 withPolicy 强制行范围/写白名单。

提供的帮助
“查看本人 / 处理全部”这类按操作区分范围的诉求可在声明层表达，服务端只需解析一次，减少手工拼接过滤条件造成的越权。
应保留的能力
无需改动；已由 IT 实现的 list/create/start/complete 四个动作验证。
E14 E15 E16 E43
做得好的地方
F5 · 可选插件缺失时 provider 与路由可干净降级

NocoBase3 内核 · @nocobase/app-server · @nocobase/service-provider

⌄

ServiceProvider 生命周期与服务容器 has() 允许 provider.boot 与路由创建器在可选插件缺席时短路，而非注册未保护的端点或崩溃。

提供的帮助
provider-only 程序集（如模板测试）仍能启动，安全默认是“缺依赖即不挂载”而非“未带授权照常服务”。
应保留的能力
无需改动；建议在指引中继续强调该降级模式。

E13 · packages/@nocobase/authorization/README.md:162–168

composite 资源内建于核心；数据范围目标类型必须声明 recordAccess:true；失效的存储授权仅跳过自身并报告。

## Composite resources and data scopes

Composites are built into the core: every Authorization has `authz.compositeResources`, handed to each plugin's `setup` as `composites`, and registers the reserved `composite` resource type itself, so no plugin is installed for them. A composite is a resource whose actions expand into a set of underlying grants, each optionally bound to a named data scope. It composes exactly what its definition lists, on any resource type; the one structural rule is that no underlying grant may target another composite, so composites never nest and never cycle. Business operations are defined as composite resources.

A grant action names a data scope with `scopeKey`. Every grant action naming the same scope must address the same one resource, and that resource is the scope's target; `dataScopeTarget(action, key)` returns it and throws when no grant action or more than one resource names the scope. The target's type must declare `recordAccess: true`. `define` checks this when the target type is already registered and throws otherwise; a type registered later is checked by `authz.compositeResources.validate()`, which lists every unfit data scope, and on first use.

A stored composite grant that no longer expands against the current definition — an unknown action, an unknown or invalid data scope value, a malformed policy, or an unfit data scope target — is skipped for that grant alone: it permits nothing, contributes nothing to the snapshot, and the identity's other grants keep working. A direct check of that composite action, with no other valid grant, denies with `INVALID_GRANT`, naming the grant's source and the problem. `createAuthorization({ onInvalidGrant })` is told once per distinct grant and problem, with `{ source, resource, action, reason }`; the library has no logger of its own. `authz.compositeResources.validateGrant({ resource, action, policy? })` returns the same problem for a stored grant, or `undefined`, so a host can scan its stored grants at startup. The library does not validate grants on save; a host that accepts grants from administrators checks them there.

    expandOrSkip(grant) {
        const reason = this.validateGrant(grant);
        if (reason === undefined)
            return this.expand(grant);
        this.report(grant, reason);
        return [];
    }

E17 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/README.md:308–346

服务端模式：authz.middleware() 提供 AuthorizationContext；authorize 后按 decision.conditions.database.<collection> 取 RepositoryPolicy 并 withPolicy 执行。

## Check access on the server

Every route installs authentication, then `authz.middleware()`, which sets the `authz` variable to the request's `AuthorizationContext`. A denied `require` throws `AuthorizationDeniedError`, which answers `403 { code: 'FORBIDDEN', message }` on its own, so a route needs no `onError` for it.

```ts
router.use('*', authentication.required(), authz.middleware());
router.post('/quotes/:id/submit', async (c) => {
  const context = c.get('authz');
  await context.require({
    resource: { type: 'settings', id: 'workflow' },
    action: 'manage',
  });
  const decision = await context.authorize({
    resource: { type: 'composite', id: 'sales.quotes' },
    action: 'submit',
  });
  if (decision.effect === 'deny') return c.json({ code: 'FORBIDDEN' }, 403);
  const quotesPolicy = decision.conditions?.database?.quotes;
  const projectsPolicy = decision.conditions?.database?.projects;
  if (!quotesPolicy || !projectsPolicy)
    return c.json({ code: 'FORBIDDEN' }, 403);
  await database.transaction(async (connection) => {
    const project = await connection
      .repository('projects')
      .withPolicy(projectsPolicy)
      .findOne({ filter: { id: projectId } });
    await connection
      .repository('quotes')
      .withPolicy(quotesPolicy)
      .updateOne({
        filter: { id: c.req.param('id') },
        values: { status: 'submitted' },
      });
  });
  return c.json({ ok: true });
});
```

A composite decision's `conditions` are `CompositeResourceConditions` with `database`: one `RepositoryPolicy` per composed collection, built from that action's grants only. `require` rejects conditional decisions, and `can` counts them as false; neither enforces rows.

先写责任矩阵（入口/动作/记录边界/数据能力），再用 defineDatabasePermission + defineCompositeResource 建模；可移植声明不查库。

## 1. Write the responsibility matrix

| Job                 | Entry            | Action                   | Record boundary                                  | Data capability                                  |
| ------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Sales assistant     | Projects, Quotes | View                     | Public/assigned materials                        | Read business fields                             |
| Sales engineer      | Quotes           | Edit draft               | Prepared by current user or explicitly delegated | Write amount and notes                           |
| Sales engineer      | Quotes           | Submit                   | Both accessible quote and responsible project    | Read parent; update quote status                 |
| Project manager     | Projects         | Maintain                 | Owned projects                                   | Write project details                            |
| Delivery specialist | Orders           | Arrange/confirm delivery | Owned/assigned orders                            | Relation operations or delivery status/reference |

Resolve unclear cases before granting access: may users consult colleagues' quotes, may a delegate submit as well as edit, and does confidentiality apply to every access path? Prefer meaningful action names to exposing all CRUD operations of every table.

## 2. Model and declare

Model ownership and preparer ids, project relations, region membership and any team or department membership as business data. Make membership changes an authorized business API. Keep credentials and fixture accounts out of production feature seeds.

Create `server/sales-resources.ts` using the complete `quotes` declaration in [runtime integration](runtime-api.md#declare-a-business-operation). `defineDatabasePermission` declares fields and relation capabilities; `defineCompositeResource` binds them to data scope keys. A `submit` action binds `quotes` to quote read and status update and `projects` to parent read. Give independently controlled collections separate keys even when a workflow edits only one of them.

Keep portable declarations free of database queries so seeds and provisioning can reuse `quotes.reference().grant(...)`. Return fluent builders from callbacks. Define translations in the owning package and use `{ key, ns }` for persisted titles. Do not repeat resource and action strings in permission sets when a typed reference is available.

E19 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/code-and-seeds.md:3–11

代码定义模型，种子提供可被管理员继续编辑的初始配置；不修改 root/member 与系统配置。

Use the sales domain of [the business module workflow](business-module.md) as the model: job permission sets, three business collections, separate page access, a two-scope quote submission, a delegated quote handover and delivery relations. For a job inherited through an organisation, build it with the application development Skill's `references/organization.md`. Code defines the business permission model; seeds provide initial business permission configuration that administrators can continue editing in the backend. Demonstration accounts and records are separate from the production permission configuration.

## Permission model versus editable configuration

Code defines composite resources, page routes, actions, readable and writable fields, relation capabilities, settings items and the available record access. These declarations describe what the business supports and how its server enforces access. For example, code defines that submitting a quote updates its status and checks its parent project; backend configuration cannot redefine that operation to write arbitrary fields.

Seeds help the user configure that model initially: create business permission sets, choose page and action grants and data scopes, initialize default/sharing/restriction rules, and assign them to intended users or teams where identities are known. These are ordinary persisted configurations, editable through the authorization backend after installation. Being declared in a seed does not make a permission set or rule code-owned, protected or resettable on startup. Preserve subsequent administrator changes.

Application feature development registers and configures its own composites. Leave platform/system permission configuration to the owning system plugins: do not modify root/member sets, their protection rules, authorization management capabilities or other system settings merely to make an App feature accessible. A business configuration page can live under Settings without becoming platform configuration; declare and configure only the business capability it owns. System-plugin development is a separate, explicitly scoped task.

export function assertTaskSourceForm(kind, options) {
    if (options.directory !== undefined && options.sources !== undefined) {
        throw new Error(`${kind} options cannot define both directory and sources.`);
    }
    if (options.directory === undefined && options.sources === undefined) {
        throw new Error(`${kind} options must define directory or sources.`);

以表格说明 Repository 负责关系读取、withPolicy 行范围/写白名单、乐观锁、游标分页、方言编码；Query 负责无关系 join、子查询、分组分页。

**Is the unit of work a Collection's records, or a result set?** Records of one Collection and the things related to them are Repository's job. A shape that is not any Collection's records — a report joining unrelated tables, a set aggregated then paginated — is Query's.

| The task needs                                       | Use        |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| Reading a relation, or a nested create/update/delete | Repository |
| Optimistic locking through a `version` field         | Repository |
| A row scope or write allow list (`withPolicy`)       | Repository |
| Cursor pagination over a stable sort                 | Repository |
| Collection-level naming overrides to be honored      | Repository |
| Dialect-correct JSON and temporal encoding on write  | Repository |
| A join between tables with no relation between them  | Query      |
| A subquery, or conditions composed programmatically  | Query      |
| Paging or limiting a grouped result                  | Query      |

The costly mistake is rebuilding a relation read as a hand-written join because the join is familiar. That loses the naming mapping, the relation metadata and the write path that goes with it, and it has to be maintained against a schema the Collection definition already describes. If the records belong to a Collection, start from Repository and only drop to Query for the part Repository genuinely cannot express.

They mix freely inside one transaction — take both from the callback `connection`, as the example in [Transactions](#5-transactions) does.

迁移写结构、种子写记录；种子固定可复现、不得覆盖用户已编辑数据；读取 nocobase-db SKILL 第 2、3 节。

How to write the files themselves — the migration and seed shape, the immutability and self-containment rules, the Collection Builder, and which of `builder`, `query` and `repository` a task context should reach for — belongs to the package that owns them. Read `.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md` sections 2 and 3 before writing one, and run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` if that file is missing.

Migrations under `database/main/migrations/` are the application's schema history. Seeds under `database/main/seeds/` insert records the application requires to run. Migrations create structure. Seeds never do.

`database/tsconfig.json` extends the server configuration so editor tooling and ESLint recognize migrations and seeds as Node source. Keep it in place when adding connection directories.

## Running

```bash
pnpm nocobase db apply
```

This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Both halves run only what is pending, so on an already-migrated database it applies seeds alone. The template defaults to `main`. Plugin migrations, seeds and runtime default reads/writes always use this same connection; changing `database.default` changes the application system database.

Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.

    return Object.freeze({
        parent: 'app',

    });
}
function freezeNavigationRoutes(routes) {
    return Object.freeze(routes.map((route) => Object.freeze({
        ...route,
        ...(route.navigation
            ? { navigation: Object.freeze({ ...route.navigation }) }
            : {}),
        ...(route.children
            ? { children: freezeNavigationRoutes(route.children) }
            : {}),
    })));
}

客户端路由认证 auth 与授权 authz 的取值与继承规则；首个页面必须声明 authz。

Client route authentication uses `auth: 'required' | 'guest' | 'optional'`. Authorization uses `authz: 'skip' | 'unrestricted' | { resource: { type, id }, action }`. Declare it on the first page of every path. A nested page that omits it inherits the effective value of its nearest ancestor page, through any number of groups and levels, and a child that declares its own value overrides it for its subtree. A first page that omits it never stops the application: protected `app` pages (`auth: 'required'`) and `settings` pages default to `'unrestricted'`, which admits only identities with unrestricted access such as root and hides the page from everyone else's menus, while `guest` and `optional` app pages and `dev` pages default to `'skip'`. Development builds log one warning per defaulted page naming its id, path and default; production logs nothing. `'unrestricted'` may also be declared explicitly for a root-only page, and it is never offered as a grant. `'skip'` applies only to the current page and does not bypass parent guards. Route groups cannot declare `authz`. Malformed values, the removed `access` field and string resource declarations are rejected.

A plugin's locale file supplies translations for those languages; it never adds one. A plugin shipping `ja-JP` to an application that does not offer Japanese contributes nothing a visitor can select — which is what keeps an installed plugin from putting an unexpected language in the picker.

## Keeping the server in step with the browser

`@nocobase/app-plugin-i18n` owns the language selector, persistence, and the server locale endpoints. The application shell calls `useSyncServerLocale()` so server messages use the browser's language when the server supports it; keep that call when changing the shell. If the server does not have that locale, the browser still switches and the server uses English; the language control shows an informational notice about the fallback.

## Which languages the application offers

The application's own locale files are the list. `client/locales/index.ts` decides what the browser offers and `server/locales/index.ts` what the server does, so adding a language means adding its file and loader entry on the side that needs it — there is no configured list to keep in step.

  /** Resolve one business action and return the policy for its one collection. */
  private async policy(
    authorization: AuthorizationContext,
    action: 'view' | 'create' | 'start' | 'complete',
  ): Promise<RepositoryPolicy> {
    const decision = await authorization.authorize({
      resource: { type: 'composite', id: IT_TICKET_RESOURCE },
      action,
    });
    const policy = decision.conditions?.database?.[IT_TICKET_COLLECTION];
    if (decision.effect === 'deny' || !policy) {
      throw new ItTicketError(
        'FORBIDDEN',
        'You are not allowed to perform this action.',
      );
    }
    return policy;

export class ItTicketsProvider extends ServiceProvider<Application> {

        ),
    );

  public override async boot(): Promise<void> {
    // Composite resources, the collection registry and the permission workspace
    // all come from the Authorization plugin. When that plugin is not part of
    // the assembly there is no registry to extend, so the feature registers
    // nothing and its routes stay unmounted; a full application always includes
    // it.
    if (!this.app.container.has(authorizationToken)) {
      return;

    });

      name: IT_TICKETS_SECTION,
      parent: 'business',
      title: { key: 'itTickets.section.title', ns: NS },
      order: 400,
    });
    authz.ui.place(reference, { section: IT_TICKETS_SECTION });
  }

export const itTicketApiRoutes: AppApiRouteContribution<Application> =
  defineApiRoutes((app) => {
    // The endpoints need a session and a business decision, both supplied by
    // plugins. An assembly without them mounts nothing rather than serving
    // tickets unprotected.
    if (
      !app.container.has(authenticationToken) ||
      !app.container.has(authorizationToken)
    ) {
      return new Hono();
    }
    const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);
    const authz = app.container.resolve(authorizationToken);
    const service = app.container.resolve(itTicketServiceToken);
    const router = new Hono<AuthEnv & AuthorizationEnv>();

    // Middleware is attached per route rather than with `use('*')`: this router
    // is mounted at the application root, and a wildcard here would also run for
    // every other contribution's paths.

E49 · app/database/main/seeds/202609300003_it_tickets_permission_sets.ts:17–46

defineSeed transaction:true，select 已存在则 continue，否则插入 authorizationPermissionSets；赋值同样幂等。

export default defineSeed({
  name: '202609300003_it_tickets_permission_sets',
  transaction: true,
  async run({ query }) {
    const now = new Date();

    for (const permissionSet of [
      itEmployeePermissionSet,
      itHandlerPermissionSet,
    ]) {
      const existing = await query
        .selectFrom('authorizationPermissionSets')
        .select('key')
        .where('key', '=', permissionSet.key)
        .executeTakeFirst();
      if (existing) {
        continue;
      }
      await query
        .insertInto('authorizationPermissionSets')
        .values({
          id: permissionSet.key,
          key: permissionSet.key,
          title: encodeAuthorizationTitle(permissionSet.title),
          grants: JSON.stringify(permissionSet.grants),
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        })
        .execute();
    }

import { itTicketsResource } from '../../server/it-tickets/resources.ts';

import { definePermissionSet } from '@nocobase/authorization/permission-sets';

export const IT_TICKETS_NAMESPACE = 'nb3-factory';

export const IT_EMPLOYEE_SET_KEY = 'it.employee';
export const IT_HANDLER_SET_KEY = 'it.handler';

/**
 * Employees submit and follow their own tickets: the page, viewing their own
 * records, and creating. `start` and `complete` are deliberately absent.
 */
export const itEmployeePermissionSet = definePermissionSet(IT_EMPLOYEE_SET_KEY)
  .title({ key: 'itTickets.permissionSet.employee', ns: IT_TICKETS_NAMESPACE })
  .grant({
    resource: { type: 'page', id: 'it.tickets' },
    actions: [{ action: 'access' }],
  })
  .grant(
    itTicketsResource.reference().grant({
      view: { tickets: 'recordsIOwn' },
      create: { tickets: 'recordsIOwn' },
    }),
  )
  .build();

/**
 * Handlers see every ticket and drive it through its lifecycle. They do not
 * create tickets, because reporting is the employee's job.
 */
export const itHandlerPermissionSet = definePermissionSet(IT_HANDLER_SET_KEY)
  .title({ key: 'itTickets.permissionSet.handler', ns: IT_TICKETS_NAMESPACE })
  .grant({
    resource: { type: 'page', id: 'it.tickets' },
    actions: [{ action: 'access' }],
  })
  .grant(
    itTicketsResource.reference().grant({
      view: { tickets: 'allRecords' },
      start: { tickets: 'allRecords' },
      complete: { tickets: 'allRecords' },
    }),
  )
  .build();

  "lessons": [
    "A route contribution mounted at the application root must not use router.use('*', ...): the wildcard applies to every other contribution's paths. Auth middleware is attached per route instead.",
    "The authentication plugin's global CSRF origin guard rejects cookie-bearing POSTs with no Origin/Referer; an HTTP integration test must send a trusted Origin.",
    "Seeds loaded by @nocobase/db in source mode go through native Node type stripping, which does not rewrite .js to .ts. The seed-reachable import chain must use .ts specifiers; tsc rewrites them to .js on emit via rewriteRelativeImportExtensions.",
    "An app provider that integrates an optional plugin should skip cleanly when the plugin is absent, so provider-only assemblies (a template test) still boot."
